name: MathFish
summary: About 21,800 K-12 math problems from Illustrative Mathematics and Fishtank Learning, labeled with the Common Core standards they address, for testing whether models can tell which standards a problem fits.

license.note: The dataset is labeled ODC-By 1.0; its Illustrative Mathematics problems are CC BY 4.0 and its Fishtank Learning problems CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). The code is Apache-2.0.

cite: Lucy, L., August, T., Wang, R. E., Soldaini, L., Allison, C., & Lo, K. (2024). Mathfish: Evaluating Language Model Math Reasoning via Grounding in Educational Curricula. arXiv:2408.04226

fits.how: No slot yet: it could test whether a problem an agent writes fits the standard in an activity's teaching settings.
